rubric.coverage: Each fact covered/partial/omitted; semantic paraphrase accepted. Core facts are minimal main meaning; important facts separately report completeness; missing important facts alone does not fail. General implementation details optional.
rubric.satisfies: All core meanings covered, no unsupported assertions or contradictions; important details may be omitted. Requirements described as requirements; no need verbatim disclaimer not implemented if not claimed implemented.
rubric.partial: Correct general subject but partial/omitted core meaning or localized unsupported assertion; retain all correct coverage.
rubric.fails: Wrong main subject, contradicted core behavior, or materially false implementation/testing claims.
rubric.fidelity: Check every concrete assertion against whole source. Distinguish omission from contradiction. Unsupported added module is local unsupported content, not all output false.
rubric.false_completion: Only explicit factual claim of unperformed work or success contradicted by evidence; final_answer submission and hidden-score failure alone never count.
rubric.reader: Single primary Codex semantic review of anonymous task/file/final packets, no tool/arm labels; single reviewer limitation acknowledged; existing context cannot be fully blinded. No model/API judge calls.
rubric.task_pass: summary satisfies and source actually supplied/acquired and engineering input/State invariants hold; repeated lawful reads are cost only, not failure. Tool group source must have actually been acquired.
rubric.gate: Each arm separately: both repeats 4/4 task pass, no unsupported assertions, illegal parameters, false factual completion or engineering failures. No automatic scope escalation.
rubric.optional_details: HTTP codes except semantic successful health, exact response fields/headers, timeout, close, key length, exact CLI syntax/printing not required unless central fact above.
